import re
for f in ["2401.16549v3.pdf.txt","2509.05019v1.pdf.txt","ADOCRNet_A_Deep_Learning_OCR_for_Arabic_Documents_Recognition.pdf.txt"]:
    t=open\(f,encoding="utf-8"\).read\(\)

    t=re.sub\(r'\\n{3,}','\\n\\n',t\)

    print\(f,len\(t\)\)
